question.whyItMatters: An unfunded trust is the most common loose end after signing.

text.text: Your estate planning practice in one place. Follow each Engagement through consultation, drafting, signing and funding, keep Instruments and Signings moving, and use Review due on Clients to bring past clients back. Operational tracking only; it holds no legal advice.
Every plan follows the same stages. Move the engagement as it advances.
Consultation: conflict check, fee estimate, engagement letter.
Gathering information: asset list, family details, goals.
Funding: assets moved into the trust.
Complete: originals stored and review date set.
Send the client what to bring
Confirm the time with the client
A signed trust only works if the right assets are in it.
Add one Funding step per asset.
Give each an owner and due date.
Contact each institution and save confirmations.
Review Funding open steps on the Dashboard until none remain.
Open Clients and look at Review due.
Send a short note offering a plan check-up.
Start a Plan update engagement for anyone who replies.
Invite clients to call after a marriage, birth, move or sale of a business.
